title: OptoAgent: A Trustworthy Multi-Agent Framework for Opportunistic Vision Micro-Screening in Classroom Environments
abstract: arXiv:2609.14514v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A child with reduced distance vision often does not know that anything is wrong. Children adapt, move closer, and rarely report the difficulty, so the problem can survive years of schooling before an adult notices. School screening addresses part of this, but it runs on a schedule, depends on staffing, and is separated from the classroom moments where the difficulty appears. Smartphone and web-based acuity tests have widened access, yet every one of them still needs somebody to start a test. We present SightSentinel, an architecture that turns a wall display a child already reads from into a recurring screening site. Ordinary educational content carries short calibrated optotype probes, and eight specialized agents divide the work. Perception agents recover viewing distance, recognition accuracy, approach behavior, gaze stability, response latency, and interocular difference from each encounter. translated_title: OptoAgent：一种用于课堂环境中机会性视觉微筛查的可信多智能体框架
translated_abstract: 视力下降的儿童往往不知道自己有问题。孩子们会去适应、靠近观看，很少主动报告困难，因此这个问题可能在成人察觉之前在学校里持续存在多年。学校筛查解决了部分问题，但它按固定时间表运行、依赖人员配备，并且与课堂上出现困难的时刻相分离。基于智能手机和网页的视力测试扩大了可及性，但每一种测试仍需要有人来启动。我们提出了SightSentinel，一种将儿童已经在阅读的墙面显示屏转变为常态化筛查站点的架构。普通的教育内容中携带简短的校准视力探针，八个专门的智能体分工协作。感知智能体从每次接触中提取观看距离、识别准确率、趋近行为、注视稳定性、响应延迟和双眼差异。质量智能体丢弃观察……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出OptoAgent多智能体框架，将教室中儿童已在阅读的墙面显示屏转变为常态化视力筛查站点，通过在日常教育内容中嵌入校准视力探针，并由八个专门智能体协作提取观看距离、识别准确率、注视稳定性等指标，实现对儿童远视力问题的机会性、持续性微筛查。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes OptoAgent, a trustworthy multi-agent framework that turns classroom wall displays children already read from into recurring vision screening sites, embedding calibrated optotype probes in ordinary educational content and using eight specialized agents to extract viewing distance, recognition accuracy, gaze stability, and other metrics for opportunistic micro-screening of children's distance vision.
